title: SP7 chance gates (jest)
description: v2.5 plan 09 SP7 D1 fixture: a gate that loops, so a code roll quality is drawn again at every re-entry at a new boundary. lock_gives is a d20 at or under 12, clue_die is the raw d6 face.

qualities.rubric: Has the party tried the gate this visit?
Does the old lock give way this visit?
The face the clue die shows this visit.

checkpoints.name: The Gate
checkpoints.objective: The party tries the old gate.

checkpoints.objective: The gate gave way; the party walks back to it.
